email-assistant.fixed: It now opens with a welcome card instead of Settings when you haven’t added an email yet.
email-assistant.added: On screen: open any email, even school email, and it reads that email and writes replies for you to copy and paste. Settings now say clearly that the daily summary works with personal email only.
email-assistant.notes:
